item.title: VoiceInk 2.25 (228f421)
item.description:
VoiceInk 2.25 (228f421)

  • Release version 2.25 (228f4217)
  • Add diagnostics for automatic mode detection and trigger matching (be9ae87d)
  • Fix Japanese localization wording (ecd2f2e6)
  • Upgrade Soniox to v6 and migrate saved model selections (648b97ac)
  • Add Japanese (ja) localization (2120bbe3)
  • Decode trigger paths and reject malformed trigger ports (d5671a48)
  • Keep path case, trailing slashes and ports out of trigger matching (f3b8815f)
  • Anchor website trigger matching to the URL host (298025c1)
